description: Contoso v7: v6's claims API and interface over v5's durable store, v3's FAQ desks, and the inputs reused from the durable-execution, skills, hosting, security, evaluation and capacity chapters. Simulated payment provider only. Supersedes contoso-v7, whose evidence-live step crashed in the evidence scorer (FJ-01); the scorer fix is CodeSample 956c463.

layers.title: Restore and build
layers.proves: the candidate restores from its lock files and compiles with no warning

layers.title: Offline contracts
layers.proves: the rules hold on scripted inputs: abstention, citations, permissions, threats, skill gates
layers.doesNotProve: anything about a real model's answers

layers.title: Integration: persistence, identity, transport
layers.proves: state survives process loss on one machine, tokens and tenants are enforced over HTTP, the stream resumes
layers.doesNotProve: model quality, load, a real payment provider, more than one machine

layers.title: Real provider
layers.proves: what this model did on these cases, in this run
layers.doesNotProve: another model, other data, the same result on the next run

layers.title: Workload
layers.proves: queueing and admission limits on this workstation, with this model
layers.doesNotProve: the capacity of another machine, provider or model

limits: Payments are simulated (FakePaymentProvider); no real payment provider is integrated, and claims.decide ships disabled.
The gate is on the HTTP API. v5's worker command line keeps its review verb; the release runbook does not hand it out.
The real-provider layer ran one small local model once; its counts describe that run only.
No cloud provider has credentials on the qualification machine: the Azure OpenAI step is compiled and declared, not run.
The host agent behind /ask and /conversations has no real-provider evaluation in this campaign; the evaluated answer paths are v3's FAQ desks and the evidence cases.
The evidence-evaluation agent's instructions are inline in its Program.cs, not a constant, so the runner does not hash them; the commit and lock files identify them.
The refund-escalation skill is frozen with the candidate, but no v7 route loads it.
Event logs and the FAQ indexes are in memory: a restarted process rebuilds them.
One machine: no test covers two API instances or two workers on different hosts.
